Final for Publication

TYPE-1 NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING CHANGE
at 4345-4347 N. Cicero Avenue, Chicago, Illinois 60641

The Applicant seeks a zoning change from B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District to B2-2
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District to allow the construction of a new 3-story residential
building containing six (6) dwelling units. This application is submitted as a Type 1 Zoning
Map Amendment pursuant to Section 17-13-0300 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

The Applicant, Tempo Realty Investments LLC, is seeking approval of a Type 1 Map
Amendment from B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District to B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use

District for the property commonly known as 4345-4347 North Cicero Avenue, Chicago,
Illinois 60641.

The subject property is a zoning lot with an approximate area of 7916.25 square feet,
based on the combined parcels measuring approximately _63.33 feet by 125.00 feet.
The property is currently improved with two existing residential buildings.

The Applicant proposes to redevelop the subject property with a new 3-story residential
building containing six (6) dwelling units. No commercial space is proposed.

The proposed development is intended to be compatible with the scale and character of the
surrounding residential and mixed-use properties along the Cicero Avenue corridor.

* ZONING (Proposed): B2-2

* LOT AREA: 7916.25 sf.

> FLOORAREARATIO: 2.2 (17415 sf. max.)
* BUILDING AREA (Total): 9789 sf. proposed

* OFF-STREET PARKING: _ six parking stalls

* FRONT SETBACK: 21'-8"
* REAR SETBACK: 30'-0"
